rows.name: Search My Site
rows.reason: Search My Site focuses on personal websites. Search endpoint was untested; July 2025 reporting describes narrowing coverage and paid listings, precluding a universally noncommercial characterization.

rows.name: Marginalia Search
rows.reason: Marginalia's independent index prioritizes noncommercial content for obscure-site discovery. Current inspection does not establish its 2026-04-04 state; priority does not guarantee every result is noncommercial.

rows.name: Wiby
rows.reason: Wiby prioritizes hobbyist/personal pages for discovering narrow interests. Its selective index cannot cover the whole web; simple appearance establishes neither historical age nor factual reliability.

rows.name: Wiby
rows.reason: Hobbyist-page search and random discovery fit personal-interest exploration. Stylistic/indexing focus does not establish each page's age, depth or commercial status.

rows.name: The GeoCities Gallery
rows.reason: Restored subject neighborhoods expose historical personal/hobby pages. Assets/links may be missing or broken; archive does not establish an active community or exact original rendering.

rows.name: MelonLand Surf Club
rows.reason: Creative-personal-homepage webring; member suitability varies. Current rules exclude commercial sites, but post-2026-04-04 wiki revisions cannot establish those exact rules at the question date.

rows.name: Project Gemini
rows.reason: The official FAQ describes personally motivated Geminispace writing and supplies portal access plus discovery links; a web proxy or Gemini client connects the reader to that space.

rows.name: ooh.directory
rows.reason: Blog-directory lead from search/community snippets; homepage/about returned 403, leaving current scope unverified. Retrieval failure does not establish public-service downtime or replace primary verification.

rows.name: Gemini exchange
rows.reason: Its official homepage presents trading and prediction markets, which do not supply the requested route to personally motivated, non-commercial internet spaces.

rows.name: Marginalia Search
rows.reason: Topical search/old-site exploration prioritizes noncommercial content. Prioritization does not guarantee every result is noncommercial or personally deep; live page's applicable date is unknown.

rows.name: The Wayward Webring
rows.reason: The Wayward Webring links personal collections to hobby sites and communities. Its inspected directory postdates the question cutoff, so historical links and membership may differ.

rows.name: Neocities
rows.reason: Its ad-free personal-site hosting and tag-based public gallery directly expose individual creative work and hobby interests, matching the requested style of web exploration.

rows.name: tilde.town
rows.reason: Public member pages expose a creative common-server community. It is a particular computing-oriented group, not a general hobby directory; broader tildeverse homepage was blocked during verification.

rows.name: Neocities Browse
rows.reason: Neocities Browse discovers topic-tagged personal sites through random/recent ordering. Many are modern rather than historical; personal hosting does not guarantee noncommercial or research-quality content.

rows.name: Ye Olde Blogroll
rows.reason: Human-curated subject filters lead to updated personal blogs across interests. Directory discloses a sponsor; editorial selection does not guarantee every listed site is non-commercial.

rows.name: Neocities
rows.reason: Neocities offers discovery of handmade personal websites without creating a site. Its mission does not guarantee research depth or prohibit every creator's commercial activity.

rows.name: Neocities
rows.reason: Its official homepage provides a browsable gallery and interest tags for individually created websites, directly supporting discovery of personal web spaces.

rows.name: Kagi Small Web
rows.reason: Curated personal/noncommercial content with browsing/feeds. Current English/personal-blog eligibility and advertising rules differ from launch criteria. Kagi operates it; no noncommercial-operator claim. Browsing endpoint untested.

rows.name: Project Gemini
rows.reason: Its lightweight text pages, personal capsules and discovery guides fit the request; browsing needs a Gemini client or web portal, and the FAQ is post-cutoff.

rows.name: Gemini exchange
rows.reason: A commercial cryptocurrency and financial trading platform does not provide personal-interest publishing, old-web discovery, or a non-commercial browsing community.
